notes.title: Update: New Faces
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34962899/709c64d07ce41534054d94fb58c972e6333265bd.png[/img]

[h3]We were not satisfied with the quality of the [b]faces[/b] of some characters, so we decided to redraw them.
The [b]new faces[/b] of the [b]teacher[/b], [b]nurse [/b]and [b]elf [/b]are already in the game.[/h3]
